description: Check any Robinhood Chain token before you buy it: is it a rug, a honeypot, a scam or a copycat? Returns { status, category, rugged, dumped }: status kept_out (Trnch keeps it out of the Heat and will not trade it), in_heat, seen or unknown, with a public risk category (SCAM_CONTRACT, LINKED_TO_PAST_RUG, HEAVY_SELL_TAX, CANNOT_SELL, COORDINATED_LAUNCH, COPYCAT, LIQUIDITY_PULLED, DUMPED, OTHER_RISK; DUMPED is a coordinated dump, not a rug). unknown means not seen by Trnch, not a pass. No key needed. A signal, never a guarantee. Full record: https://trnch.fun/tia
